author: Gene Holcombe
text:
no there is no calibration option.  A low like you experienced is a compression low.  Stop compressing the sensor and it should return to normal values.  Unless of course you compressed it so much that it is damaged.
Are you unaware of a compression low?  WHy?

author: Marnie Ferrell Gosser
text: I turn from side to side at night and I can’t find an area on the back of my arm that isn’t compressed when I’m laying on my side. Where else can we put it that works well that won’t be compressed??
